body.message:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Thank you for your reply. It does not answer my email of 5 September and it contains statements that contradict your own messages. For the record:

**1. The owner's arrival date.** You now write that my extension request was made "on the same day as the owner's arrival". Your own message of 4 September at 14:24 states that the owner had reserved the apartment "from Sunday onwards" — 6 September. Please confirm which of the two is correct and provide the owner's booking confirmation, showing its creation date and its check-in date.

**2. "Reservation terms".** You refer to "the reservation terms". No booking agreement, terms and conditions or house rules were ever provided to me at any point during four months of occupation. Please send them now, together with proof of when they were provided to me.

**3. The alleged notice of 13 August.** I have no communication from you dated 13 August concerning a deadline to confirm an extension. Your message of 12 August concerned the payment of the August rent. Your message of 27 August stated that "Sep so far is available" and invited me to contact your helpline for the extension, which I did. Please provide the 13 August message you rely on.

**4. The extension request.** I stated that I wished to stay and asked for the annual price on 4 September at 10:05. At 10:17 your official account confirmed in writing that your agent had quoted me a 12-month tenancy at AED 250,000. Between 26 June and 3 August your agent repeatedly confirmed that annual terms were available and set out a full payment schedule. It was on the strength of those written representations that I did not look for alternative housing. A holiday-home licence does not entitle an operator to make written representations of that kind and then withdraw them without notice.

**5. Your DET registration.** The DET Holiday Homes register for this unit shows a Lease Expiry Date of 04/02/2026. My request of 5 September for the current Ejari/lease and the current DET permit remains unanswered.

**6. Conduct at the apartment.** Representatives attended the apartment and behaved in a manner that disturbed and frightened my two infant children. Following advice from Dubai Police, I am filing a formal report at the police station in respect of that conduct. Any further attendance at the apartment without my prior written consent will be reported immediately.

**7. Your responsibility to resolve this with the owner.** An operator cannot make written commitments over a period of two months — repeatedly confirming that annual terms were available, quoting a price and a full payment schedule, and acknowledging that quotation in writing on 4 September — and then reverse its position overnight. Whatever arrangement exists between fäm Living and the owner of this unit is a matter between you and the owner. It is not something you may resolve at the expense of a paying guest and two infant children.

It is not possible for me to vacate a four-bedroom family home in two hours, nor in twenty-four hours. I am a single mother of a 3-year-old and an 18-month-old, with staff who depend on this household, and I run my own business in the UAE. Moving a family requires securing suitable accommodation, a lease, movers and a reasonable transition — none of which can be arranged in the time you have allowed.

I therefore require fäm Living to find a solution with the owner: either the owner's booking is rescheduled or relocated, or you provide my family with an equivalent three-bedroom-plus-maid's-room unit on the same terms, or you agree in writing to a reasonable transition period. Whichever route you choose, the consequences of your own commitments cannot be transferred to me and my children.

I therefore repeat, for the third time in writing, that I am willing to pay for September at the rate you last quoted (AED 12,500) and to conclude the annual tenancy at AED 250,000. Please either send me the payment link for September or confirm in writing that you refuse to accept payment.

All of the above, together with your reply, has been added to DET case no. GOV-320439-W0F0Q.

All my rights are reserved.
